description: Tasks for the LegacyBanking Azure cloud-readiness modernization plan, scoped to the selected assessment categories.

tasks.requirements: Replace local or network file I/O (System.IO.File usage in src/LegacyBanking.Data/BankingDbContext.cs) with cloud-appropriate storage handling so the application is portable to Azure App Service/containers. Preserve existing data read/write behavior.

Replace the legacy System.Data.SqlClient dependency with the actively maintained Microsoft.Data.SqlClient package across the solution. Update namespaces, package references, and connection handling. This is a prerequisite for Managed Identity based Azure SQL connectivity.

tasks.description: Migrate from SQL Server to Managed Identity Based Azure SQL Database
tasks.requirements: Migrate the on-premises SQL Server connection (Web.config connection string 'LegacyBanking') to Azure SQL Database using Managed Identity (passwordless authentication). Remove SQL credentials from connection strings and rely on Azure AD/Managed Identity token-based access.

tasks.description: Migrate from Windows AD to Microsoft Entra ID
tasks.requirements: Replace Windows Authentication (detected in src/LegacyBanking.Web/Web.config) with Microsoft Entra ID authentication. Update the web application authentication configuration and pipeline to use Entra ID while preserving existing authorization behavior.

tasks.description: Migrate from Plaintext Credentials to Secured Credentials protected by Managed Identity and Azure Key Vault
tasks.requirements: Move plaintext connection strings and secrets (connection strings without configuration builders in src/LegacyBanking.Web/Web.config) into Azure Key Vault, accessed via Managed Identity. Remove embedded credentials from configuration files.
